"score_team_1": 3,
"score_team_2": 0,
"team1_win_probability": 82,
"draw_probability": 12,
"team2_win_probability": 6,

"white_hat": "Argentina are reigning World Cup champions (2022) and Copa America champions (2024), ranked in the top 2 globally by FIFA. They boast Lionel Messi, Lautaro Martinez, and a deep squad. Austria are a solid European side ranked around 25th, qualifying comfortably for Euro 2024, but have never won a major international tournament. Head-to-head historically favors Argentina significantly.",

"red_hat": "Argentina carries the aura of champions with Messi still capable of magical moments. The emotional weight of defending the World Cup title gives them immense motivation. Austria, while disciplined, may feel overwhelmed against the Argentine atmosphere and quality. The Albiceleste's momentum and collective confidence feels nearly unstoppable at a tournament level.",

"black_hat": "Argentina could be overconfident or complacent against a lower-profile opponent. Messi at 38-39 may show signs of age. Austria under Ralf Rangnick play high-pressing organized football that could disrupt Argentina's buildup. Injuries or yellow card accumulation could weaken Argentina. Tournament upsets happen, and Austria's European preparation may surprise.",

"yellow_hat": "Argentina possess world-class talent across every position. Their tactical flexibility under Scaloni, proven tournament experience, and the psychological edge of being champions are massive advantages. Lautaro, Di Maria replacements, and strong defensive cohesion make them formidable. Austria lack the individual quality and tournament pedigree to compete at this level consistently.",

"green_hat": "An unconventional scenario: Rangnick's high-press causes early chaos, Austria score first, and Argentina struggle psychologically. Alternatively, a VAR controversy could swing momentum. Messi could be marked out of the game entirely, forcing lesser-known Argentine players to step up. Austria's Bundesliga-heavy squad could exploit specific defensive vulnerabilities in transition play.",

"blue_hat": "Synthesizing all hats: White Hat confirms Argentina's overwhelming statistical and ranking superiority. Yellow Hat reinforces their strengths as defending champions with elite squad depth. Red Hat adds emotional momentum favoring Argentina. Black Hat raises legitimate but manageable risks around Austria's pressing system and potential Argentine complacency. Green Hat scenarios remain unlikely but non-zero. The consensus strongly favors Argentina winning comfortably. A 3-0 scoreline reflects Argentina's quality while acknowledging Austria won't be completely overrun. Probabilities set at 82% Argentina win, 12% draw, 6% Austria win."
}
